title: Organ Harvest
subtitle: Test your understanding of Organ Harvest — the systematic extraction of human organs during engineered mass-mortality events, counted as the harvest toll.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Organ Harvest is the systematic extraction and collection of human biological organs during engineered mass-mortality events run by parasitic custodians and bloodline families. The harvest toll counts those deaths, and the appendix was intentionally left inside the downsized human vessel. Recognizing wars, plagues, and famines as deliberate harvest events cuts off panic and preserves emotional sovereignty.

questions.question: What is the primary operational definition of Organ Harvest?

options.label: A

options.rationale: Wars famines plagues and disasters are manufactured harvesting operations rather than unpreventable accidents.

options.label: B
options.text: Organ Harvest is the routine medical transplantation of tissues organized by modern civilian health networks.
options.rationale: Civilian medicine supplies a credibility shield rather than the definition of the systematic harvest.

options.label: C
options.text: Organ Harvest is the systematic extraction and collection of human biological organs from physical vessels during engineered cataclysms.
options.rationale: Organ Harvest is the systematic extraction and collection of human biological organs from physical vessels during engineered mass-mortality events.

options.label: D
options.text: Organ Harvest is the illegal black-market trafficking of organs conducted strictly by isolated criminal cartels.
options.rationale: The process is a custodial liquidation through engineered cataclysms rather than isolated cartel trafficking.
